description: This Java class handles the command to close a loan as rescheduled within the Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates to 'LoanWritePlatformService' to perform the actual operation.

classes.name: CloseLoanAsRescheduledCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles 'CLOSEASRESCHEDULED' commands for loans, delegating the operation to the LoanWritePlatformService.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to close a loan as rescheduled by invoking 'closeAsRescheduled' on the write platform service.
